subject: Security intake: SIG/CAIQ call availability + artifact handoff
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@integral-tech.com>
To: monica.patel@redwood.ai
Cc: Oliver Park <oliver.park@integral-tech.com>
Date: 2025-07-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG + CAIQ intake — availability and quick ask

Hi Monica,

We’re kicking off the SIG/CAIQ review on our side and would like to schedule a 45-minute intake call to walk through the workbook and alignment on evidence handoff. Suggested attendees from Integral: myself (security lead), Oliver (platform), and procurement as needed. From Redwood, could you include someone who owns SOC2 artifacts and someone who can speak to logging/retention?

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue 7/22 11:00–11:45
- Wed 7/23 10:00–10:45 or 15:00–15:45

Quick asks ahead of the call:
- Do you have a SOC 2 summary / letter we can reference?
- We’ll need a sample of service logs (redacted) and a high-level network diagram showing ingress/egress controls.
- Can you confirm where to upload the filled CAIQ workbook (Drive link or secure upload)?

Thanks — Samira

Samira Khan
Head of Security, Integral Tech
samira.khan@integral-tech.com
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@integral-tech.com>
Cc: Oliver Park <oliver.park@integral-tech.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-07-22T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG + CAIQ intake — availability and quick ask

Thanks Samira — we’re available and happy to run the intake.

Confirmed slot: Wed 7/23 10:00–10:45 PST — I’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda.

Attendees from Redwood:
- Monica Patel (security onboarding lead)
- Marissa Cole (compliance manager)
- Aditya Rao (platform engineering)

What we’ll bring to the call:
- SOC 2 summary (attaching a single-page stub) — redwood_soc2-summary.pdf
- High-level network diagram (attaching) — network_diagram_v2.png
- Intake process + evidence timeline and expected artifact types

Can you please:
1) Share the CAIQ workbook (we prefer a shared Drive link) or upload it to the HubSpot secure folder;
2) Confirm whether you want logs delivered via secure S3 or as redacted CSV attachments;
3) Let us know if procurement should join the call.

Agenda (proposed, 10:00–10:45):
- 10:00 Introductions & goals (5m)
- 10:05 Redwoods intake process & timeline (10m)
- 10:15 CAIQ walkthrough: gaps and owners (15m)
- 10:30 Evidence handoff logistics (10m)
- 10:40 Next steps & action owners (5m)

I’ll include the Drive link in the calendar event. See you Wednesday.

— Monica
Monica Patel
Security Programs, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-07-23T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: prep for 10:00 intake with Integral Tech

Marissa / Aditya — quick prep ahead of the 10:00 call with Integral. Notes and who owns what:

- Marissa: lead through SOC 2 summary and expected artifact list. Bring the evidence mapping template and be ready to call out which items are in our SOC2 scope vs out-of-scope.
- Aditya: be ready to answer questions about logging retention, sample logs availability, and S3 transfer for sample logs. Also have someone on standby who can speak to our VPC egress controls.

Attachments I’ll reference on the call: network_diagram_v2.png, redwood_soc2-summary.pdf. I’ve dropped the CAIQ link from Integral in the Drive folder and pre-populated the basic info where possible.

Quick reminders: keep PII out of log samples (redact IPs/user ids). If they ask for historical retention counts, we should provide high-level numbers only (no raw exports in the meeting).

See you at 10.
— M
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@integral-tech.com>, Oliver Park <oliver.park@integral-tech.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai

- Confirmed SOC 2 summary and network diagram align with what Integral needs for initial review.
- Discussed log sample delivery options; Integral prefers secure S3 upload.

- Monica / Marissa: provide evidence mapping sheet with SOC2 references and suggested file locations — monica.patel@redwood.ai / marissa.cole@redwood.ai — due 2025-07-25.
- Aditya: prepare a 3-day redacted log sample (application + auth events), place on secure S3 and share presigned URL with Samira — due 2025-07-27.
- Monica: share HubSpot record for tracking and DocuSign link template if procurement requests a Data Processing Addendum — due 2025-07-25.

Attachments delivered: integral_sig_workbook_filled.xlsx (placeholder — Integral to overwrite after upload), redwood_soc2-summary.pdf, network_diagram_v2.png

Links: Drive folder: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Integral-SIG-Workbook
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890
